goal: Allow node operators to manually designate peers for BIP152 high-bandwidth compact block relay
Ensure low-latency links and multi-site setups announce compact blocks immediately and after reconnects
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Supports giving operators explicit control to override the three-peer cap (jeanpablojp, Bicaru20)
Suggested implementing this as a whitelist permission, which the author adopted (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it adds an opt-in operational feature for multi-location nodes and custom peering links
Provides clear relay reliability for specialized setups but is deferrable for general node operation
